analysis.scoreReason: RSI 과매도 탈출 + MACD 개선세 유지

analysis.reasonEn: RSI moved from 43.9 to 61.4, confirming exit from oversold territory. MACD histogram improved from -1.2182 to 5.9805, maintaining its upward trend. The 5-day low of $557.56 is higher than the 20-day low of $537.73, forming a Higher Low pattern. Following four consecutive days of gains, volume decreased during the pullback, indicating a technical rebound attempt.
